data.body: S1 ee8a CLOSED. Full delivery: Gerrit 2237 merged to main (LLM-Review + Verified from the bots), plan-review re-certified, 14/14 criteria ticked and each backed by a passing test, completion-verifier close gate passed. Close required THREE gate layers I had to work through: stale-material (attestation must cover the updated file_impact), unticked criteria (the gate requires each - [ ] actually ticked), and stale-code (merging 2237 moved origin/main out from under the reviewed code state — ticking itself is attestation-safe as documented). Structural lesson for the epic: plan-review attestations DECAY as main advances, so closes should be batched close to their reviews. Corrects my earlier claim that a stale plan-review does not block a close — it does.
